method.value: Compare PA from C43-1 and C43-4 (>250 m), absolute differences folded to 0-90 deg; sources convolved to common linear resolution; G28 and I18360 excluded; K-S test vs random 3D angles

evidence.quote: we took the absolute values of the relative orientations and limited the relative angles from $0^\circ$ to $90^\circ$

analysis_steps.goal: Column density map and projected Rayleigh statistic vs density

method.value: 1.3 mm continuum to N_H with kappa=1 cm2/g at 230 GHz, beta=1.5, T from CH3OH; normalized PRS (alignment measure) vs column density; RO with local gravity

evidence.quote: We converted the 1.3-mm continuum emission to column densities, using the dust opacity law $\kappa =  ({\nu \over THz})^\beta$ (cite: hildebrand1983) and a dust emissivity spectral index $\beta$ of 1.5

assumptions.value: beta=1.5; dust opacity 1 cm2/g at 230 GHz; dust temperature = gas temperature (~100 K)

evidence.quote: This formulation results in a dust opacity of 1 $cm^2~g^{-1}$ at 230 GHz

validation.value: Comparison of RO with local gravity direction

evidence.quote: the magnetic field is mostly parallel to the direction of the inferred gravitational force

findings_qualitative.value: Parallel alignment excess at N_H > 1e23 cm^-2 and aligned with gravity direction in NGC 6334

evidence.quote: at column densities greater than $10^{23}$ cm$^{-2}$, the magnetic field is mostly parallel to the $N_{{\rm H}_{2}}$ structures and the direction of local gravity

claims.hypothesis: Magnetic field orientations at envelope scale are correlated with those at core scale
claims.experiment: RO between C43-1 and C43-4-restricted PA, K-S test vs random
claims.result: Bimodal ROs peaking at 0 and 90 deg; K-S p=6e-6 (all), 2e-9 (NGC 6334)
claims.finding: Envelope-scale fields are aligned with or orthogonal to core fields

evidence.quote: Magnetic fields at the $10^3$ au envelope scale are correlated with the magnetic fields in the cores.

claims.hypothesis: Gravitational collapse causes the parallel ROs at high density
claims.experiment: Normalized PRS vs column density and RO with local gravity in NGC 6334
claims.result: Parallel excess above 1e23 cm^-2; field parallel to gravity from 5e22 to 2e24
claims.finding: Gravity drags and reorients the field

evidence.quote: We found an excess of parallel magnetic fields at column densities $> 10^{23}$ cm$^{-2}$.

why_this_data.value: Follow-up of SMA study at higher resolution to probe 10^3 au envelope scales

evidence.quote: The goal of this ALMA study is to image the magnetic field at protostellar envelope scale of $10^3$ au.

limitations_admitted.value: G14 RO distribution cannot be distinguished from random due to small numbers; G28 and I18360 excluded

evidence.quote: the hypothesis that the RO distribution in G14 is randomly distributed cannot be ruled out due to small number statistics

referee_caveats_inferred: PRS and gravity analysis only for NGC 6334
Independent samples reduced by factor ~4 relative to pixel counts, K-S p-values may be overstated
Dust temperature assumed equal to gas temperature; no uncertainty propagation
Gravity from plane-of-sky column density only
